title: DHT11 Aag Nahi Dekhta, Sirf Garmi Pakadta Hai 🔥 #shorts
description:
Kya DHT11 aag dekh sakta hai? Nahi! Ye sirf hawa ki garmi aur nami naapta hai.
Thermistor aur capacitor ka asli raaz, 55 second mein.
🔥 Andar NTC thermistor: garmi badhi, resistance gira
💧 Nami ke liye capacitive element
📡 Ek wire par 40 bit ka digital signal
📏 0–50 °C, ±2 °C, bas 1 reading per second
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ko, har hafte naya module khol ke dekhenge!
#shorts #DHT11 #Arduino #Sensor #ElectronicsHindi #Makers #EchoLab3D #Thermistor
